name: softglaze
description: SoftGlaze plugins for Claude: SoftGlaze Browser (isolated browser profiles). The SoftGlaze Proxy Switcher plugin joins when the extension is live.

plugins.name: softglaze-browser
plugins.description: Skills for SoftGlaze Browser profiles, proxies, macros and page tools in Claude. Pair it with softglaze-browser-connector for the tools. Every change waits for your approval in the app.

plugins.name: softglaze-browser-connector
plugins.description: Connects Claude Code to SoftGlaze Browser's AI tools on this computer (local bridge to 127.0.0.1). Install it with softglaze-browser.
